contentObjective: I can divide multi-digit whole numbers and explain the meaning of the quotient and remainder.

vocabulary.definition: A step-by-step set of rules or instructions to solve a math problem.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Un conjunto de pasos o instrucciones para resolver un problema de matemáticas.
vocabulary.cloze: A step-by-step set of rules to solve a problem is called an ___.

examples.text: Long Division Algorithm — D (Divide), M (Multiply), S (Subtract), B (Bring Down)
examples.why: It is a repeatable step-by-step process.

vocabulary.definition: The total number being divided into equal groups (the number inside the division bracket).
vocabulary.definitionEs: El número total que se divide en grupos iguales (el número dentro de la galera de división).
vocabulary.visual: In 1,344 ÷ 12 = 112, the dividend is 1,344 — the total amount being divided
vocabulary.cloze: In 84 ÷ 7, the total amount 84 being divided is the ___.

examples.text: The 252 in 252 ÷ 6 (the total amount inside the bracket)
examples.why: It is the total amount being divided.
That is the divisor (the group size).

vocabulary.definition: The number of equal groups you are dividing into (the number outside the division bracket).
vocabulary.definitionEs: El número de grupos iguales en que divides (el número fuera de la galera de división).
vocabulary.visual: In 1,344 ÷ 12 = 112, the divisor is 12 — the number of equal groups
vocabulary.cloze: In 84 ÷ 7, the number 7 that you divide by is the ___.

examples.text: The 6 in 252 ÷ 6 (the number outside the bracket)
examples.why: It is the number of equal groups you divide into.

vocabulary.visual: In 156 ÷ 12 = 13, the quotient is 13 — there are 13 groups
vocabulary.cloze: The answer to a division problem is called the ___.

examples.why: It is the result of dividing.
That is the dividend you started with.

vocabulary.definition: What is left over when a number does not divide evenly.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Lo que sobra cuando un número no se divide de forma exacta.
vocabulary.visual: 17 ÷ 5 = 3 R 2 means 3 groups of 5 with 2 left over
vocabulary.cloze: When a number does not divide evenly, the amount left over is the ___.

examples.why: 20 divides evenly by 5, so there is no remainder.

vocabulary.definition: Separate a multi-digit number into equal groups to find a quotient.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Separar un número de varias cifras en grupos iguales para hallar un cociente.
vocabulary.cloze: Long division repeats four steps: divide, multiply, subtract, ___ ___.

examples.why: The cycle runs until the last digit is used.

examples.text: Stopping at 12 with the 4 still waiting
examples.why: A digit left unused means the quotient is unfinished.

vocabulary.definition: A method that repeats four steps — divide, multiply, subtract, bring down — until there are no digits left to bring down.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Un método que repite cuatro pasos — divide, multiplica, resta, baja — hasta que no quedan dígitos por bajar.
vocabulary.visual: 1,344 ÷ 12 → divide, multiply, subtract, bring down, repeat
vocabulary.cloze: The method that repeats divide, multiply, subtract, and bring down is called ___.

examples.text: Divide, multiply, subtract, bring down — repeated to the last digit
Dividing once and writing a remainder immediately
examples.why: The cycle has to repeat until every digit is used.

vocabulary.definition: The fourth step of long division: move the next digit of the dividend down next to what is left, then start the cycle again.
vocabulary.definitionEs: El cuarto paso de la división larga: baja el siguiente dígito del dividendo junto a lo que sobró y vuelve a empezar el ciclo.
vocabulary.visual: 13 − 12 = 1, then bring down the 4 to make 14
vocabulary.cloze: After you subtract in long division, the next step is to ___ the next digit.

examples.text: Moving the 4 of 1,134 down beside the leftover 2
examples.why: The next digit joins what is left.
Digits come down into the work, not up into the quotient.

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: School District Size
revealWordProblem.text: A large school district has 621,000 students in grades kindergarten through 12. The district currently has 1 teacher for every 20 students but plans to hire more teachers to have 1 teacher for every 15 students. How many teachers does the school district need to hire to reach its goal?
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: The district hires 10,350 teachers. It currently has 621,000 ÷ 20 = 31,050 teachers, and it needs 621,000 ÷ 15 = 41,400 teachers to reach the new ratio. The difference is 41,400 − 31,050 = 10,350 teachers to hire.

reviewCheck.stem: A warehouse has 2,184 items to pack into boxes of 14. How many boxes are needed?
choiceFeedback: 146 boxes × 14 = 2,044 items, which leaves 140 items unpacked. Multiply your answer by 14 and check that it rebuilds exactly 2,184.
14 × 166 = 2,324, which is more items than the warehouse actually has. Check the tens digit of your quotient.
14 × 155 = 2,170, which leaves 14 items with no box. Multiply back to test whether your quotient uses up every item.
hints: The question asks how many groups of 14 fit into 2,184 — that phrase 'how many boxes' signals division.
Estimate to anchor yourself: 14 × 150 = 2,100 is close to 2,184. Then set it up as long division and run the cycle.
DIVIDE: 21 ÷ 14 → 1. MULTIPLY: 1 × 14 = 14. SUBTRACT: 21 − 14 = 7. BRING DOWN the 8 to make 78, then repeat the cycle.
reviewCheck.stemEs: Un almacén tiene 2,184 artículos para empacar en cajas de 14. ¿Cuántas cajas se necesitan?
hintsEs: La pregunta es cuántos grupos de 14 caben en 2,184: esa frase 'cuántas cajas' indica división.
Estima para ubicarte: 14 × 150 = 2,100 está cerca de 2,184. Luego escríbelo como división larga y repite el ciclo.
DIVIDE: 21 ÷ 14 → 1. MULTIPLICA: 1 × 14 = 14. RESTA: 21 − 14 = 7. BAJA el 8 para formar 78 y repite el ciclo.
